Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Samiti is an organization that aims to provide quality education to students in Uttar Pradesh, India. The organization is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive learning environment for all students.

As per official notification, the organization is responsible for the recruitment of Special Educators for its schools in Uttar Pradesh.

About the Programme

The Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Special Educator Recruitment 2026 is a programme aimed at recruiting qualified and dedicated Special Educators for its schools in Uttar Pradesh, India. The programme is designed to provide opportunities for candidates who are passionate about teaching and working with students with special needs.

The objective of the programme is to create a pool of skilled and committed Special Educators who can provide high-quality education and support to students with special needs.
